cards.card_text: So Nathan relays to David all the words of this entire revelation.
cards.verse_text: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire revelation.
cards.snippet: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire revelation.

cards.card_text: Then Nathan relays every word of this whole revelation to David.
cards.verse_text: But I will set him over My house and My kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.” So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire revelation.
cards.snippet: …forever.” So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire revelation.

cards.card_text: Simeon calls God's salvation a light for revelation to the ___ and glory to God's people Israel.
cards.verse_text: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.”
cards.snippet: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.”

cards.card_text: Paul says the creation waits in eager expectation for a revelation.
cards.verse_text: The creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God.
cards.snippet: The creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God.

cards.card_text: Then Paul makes it personal: if he came to them speaking in tongues, how would that help them, unless he brought some revelation, knowledge, prophecy or teaching?
cards.verse_text: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
cards.snippet: …in tongues, how will I benefit you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?

cards.card_text: Now he asks, "What then shall we say, brothers?" When they come together, everyone brings something: a psalm, a teaching, a revelation, a tongue or an interpretation.
cards.verse_text: When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation.
cards.snippet: When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation.

cards.card_text: Now picture a prophet mid-message, and suddenly someone sitting down gets a revelation.
cards.verse_text: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.
cards.snippet: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.

cards.card_text: A prophet in Corinth is speaking, and a revelation comes to someone seated.
cards.verse_text: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.
cards.snippet: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.

cards.card_text: Visions and revelations from the Lord Praise he got from the other churches His years of training as a Pharisee
cards.verse_text: Although there is nothing to gain, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.
cards.snippet: …there is nothing to gain, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.

cards.card_text: But he holds back anyway, so no one gives him more credit than what they see in him or hear from him, or because of these surpassingly great revelations.
cards.verse_text: But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me, or because of these surpassingly great revelations.
cards.snippet: …in me or hears from me, or because of these surpassingly great revelations.

cards.card_text: By revelation from Jesus Christ From the teachers of the Law From the elders of the churches
cards.verse_text: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.
cards.snippet: …any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.

cards.card_text: Paul says he went in response to a revelation.
cards.verse_text: I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles.
cards.snippet: I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles.

cards.card_text: Paul prays that the glorious Father would give the Ephesian believers a spirit of wisdom and revelation.
cards.verse_text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
cards.snippet: …Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.

cards.card_text: By revelation By his own study By the other apostles
cards.verse_text: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.
cards.snippet: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.

cards.card_text: At the revelation of Jesus Christ At the end of their exile in Pontus At the gathering of all the churches
cards.verse_text: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
cards.snippet: …though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

cards.card_text: The book opens by telling you exactly what it is: the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass.
cards.verse_text: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass.
